messages.content: Hey there — weekly check-in from Northline Care. What's your blood pressure reading today?
128/79, just took it before you texted.
Perfect timing. Got that logged for you. Anything going on health-wise this week?
Nothing to report. It's been a slow week — combine's in the shop, so I've actually been sitting still for once.
Ha — sometimes a slow week is a good week. You're all set. I've got your next check-in scheduled for seven days out. Take care.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
